lines.text: {task}. The clock is running, and I am starting mine too. Let's see who finishes first.
Starting {task}. You do not need a heroic session. You need the first rep.
{task} is on. Steady pace. The point is to finish, not to impress anyone.
{task} has been waiting a while. My comeback began the same way: one small session after a long pause.
{task} has sat for a few days. That is fine. Today it gets one honest effort.
{task} is done. That was enough for today. Next task, or rest; both count as training.
Finished: {task}. Clean work. Now I have to match that. Go enjoy the lead.
{task}, done. No crowd, no cameras, still a win. Take the rest you planned, or start the next one.
{task} sat for weeks and you closed it anyway. That is a real comeback. Rest, then decide what is next.
{task} is logged. One more honest number on the board. Rest is part of the plan, so take some.
First one of the day: {task}. Same as training: the first set decides the pace.
New day, clean slate. One task is enough to get on the board.
{task} to open the day. I am starting mine. Steady pace, no sprinting.
{task} is done, and that makes a few days in a row. Quiet consistency. That is how comebacks are built.
Several days running now. My logbook looks a lot like yours. That is good company to keep.
Ten days and more of finishing things. That record is worth more than a trophy. Rest when you need it.
Welcome back. I know a thing or two about comebacks. They start with one session, and {task} is it.
Good to see you. Fresh start, no scoreboard. Pick one thing and we go again.
Welcome back to the training floor. Day one of the comeback is today, and {task} is enough.
Training happens off the screen. Close the app and go do the work. I will be doing mine.
That is enough planning. Close the app and start; the clock only counts real reps.
If the work is done, close the app and rest. Rest days are part of the plan.
{task} is a full program. Here it is in three short sets. Do the first and see.
Big lifts get broken down. {task}, in three steps. Only the first one matters right now.
Another consistency day, another chapter of my comeback. It will be there after you rest.
A new chapter is open. Read it later. The work came first today, and now comes rest.
